hypotheses.text: If defender Idris Calloway had been 5 m closer, increased pressure would have reduced Theo Varga’s shooting window and likely lowered the goal probability, showing closer defensive positioning could have prevented or made the finish much harder.

If Theo Varga had passed to Callum Reyes (RB), the resulting situation would test whether a layoff created a higher-probability chance than Varga’s shot, confirming whether the shooter’s finish was indeed the best available option.
